data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin 'Allanus', meaning 'ruler of men'. In Christian tradition, this name is associated with Allan the Breton, a 5th-century saint known for his leadership and devotion to God. The name Allanson carries the meaning “Ruler of men” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Allanson usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of men and live with faith, good character and purpose.
